Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headache beginning shortly after the
event. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reporetd symptoms, and the force involved in the impact is in keeping with
a cervical strain. Over five visits the patient received manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program.
Treatment followed a typical course, with pain scores and functional limitations improving steadily, and visit frequency was
reduced accordingly as recovery progressed. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion
were documented and support the reported injury. Neurological screening, inlcuding reflexes, strength, and sensation, was within
normal limits. Records also show a remote soft-tissue srtain to the same region that resolved completely without lasting deficit.
Billing entries for similar services on the same day are under review. Current status: improving, with discharge from active care
anticipated once the home program is independently maintained.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
